errors.text: The cited evidence concerns unrelated Cr-containing high-entropy alloys and provides no direct support for FeCoNiTi, Ti-mediated antiferromagnetic coupling, or the claimed 667 Oe coercivity.
The proposed 100–500 K comparison cannot observe or assign the approximately 1084 K fcc ordering transition.

The falsification rule stating that lower coercivity in a C14-dominant alloy would undermine the hypothesis is logically incorrect: lower coercivity in either single-phase control would support a dual-phase interfacial-pinning mechanism.
